zh.title: 颱風白海豚影響星宇與長榮航空調整沖繩航班
zh.summary: 星宇航空與長榮航空受颱風白海豚影響，宣布調整2026年8月7日至8日往返沖繩及下地島的航班。星宇航空取消了部分台中往返下地島與沖繩的航班，長榮航空則取消此兩日所有往返沖繩的航班。
body: 星宇航空與長榮航空受颱風白海豚影響，調整8月7日至8日台灣往返沖繩及下地島航班。星宇航空取消8月7日台中-下地島JX308/JX309，並取消8月8日台中-沖繩JX302/JX303及JX312/JX313；8月8日台北-沖繩JX870及JX871延後起飛，並安排加班機JX1870/JX1871疏運旅客。
長榮航空繼8月7日沖繩航班全日取消後，亦取消8月8日沖繩全日航班。此外，根據歷史紀錄，中華航空先前已取消8月6日至8日往返沖繩航班共14架次；星宇航空先前亦曾於8月4日宣布，因應颱風調整8月5日台中往返沖繩與熊本的航班。

en.title: Typhoon White Dolphin Prompts Flight Adjustments by Starlux and EVA Air
en.summary: Due to Typhoon White Dolphin, Starlux Airlines and EVA Air have announced adjustments to their flights between Taiwan and Okinawa, as well as Shimojishima, for August 7 and 8, 2026. Starlux Airlines has cancelled several flights operating from Taichung and delayed its Taipei–Okinawa services while adding extra flights to assist passengers. Meanwhile, EVA Air has cancelled all of its flights scheduled between Taiwan and Okinawa for both days.
body: Due to the impact of Typhoon White Dolphin, Starlux Airlines and EVA Air have adjusted their flights between Taiwan and Okinawa, as well as Shimojishima, for August 7 and 8, 2026. Starlux Airlines cancelled its Taichung–Shimojishima flights JX308/JX309 on August 7, and its Taichung–Okinawa flights JX302/JX303 and JX312/JX313 on August 8. Additionally, Starlux delayed its August 8 Taipei–Okinawa flights JX870/JX871 and scheduled extra flights JX1870/JX1871 to assist passengers.

EVA Air announced that following the cancellation of all its Okinawa flights on August 7, all of its flights to and from Okinawa on August 8 have also been cancelled. Previously, China Airlines cancelled 14 flights between Taiwan and Okinawa from August 6 to 8, while Starlux Airlines adjusted its August 5 flights between Taichung and Okinawa/Kumamoto on August 4 due to the typhoon.
